verifiedBehaviors: Capsule internal module/category navigation and last-to-first transitions keep the window visible and project the selected cards.
Native mouse navigation passes at 144 DPI in detached and borrowed input modes.
Outside clicks close Capsule while reaching the external fixture window.
Internal navigation preserves the exact borrowed input lease and does not activate Capsule.
Physical hit testing restores the caller DPI awareness context after temporarily switching context.
limitations: The external TSF target is synthetic; these fixtures are not acceptance tests in every desktop application.
Native navigation was tested at 144 DPI; mixed-DPI monitor transitions are not covered by this run.
observations: Early native fixtures used fixed delays and per-window message filtering. Diagnostic traces showed cancellation completing while the fixture failed to observe the click. The final fixture uses a thread-wide message queue, tagged complete down/up cycles, atomic positioned clicks and a temporary pointer constraint restored after each click. Each architecture subsequently passed three native runs.
These are local validation results, not remote CI or a published release.
